verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, or Cloud Spanner features such as automated backups, HA configurations, or maintenance windows — the only reference to a managed relational database is a passing community mention of 'CloudSQL databases' in an outage complaint (google-cloud-comm-14), which does not describe any of the story's specific capabilities. Missing for 10: docs on automated backups, HA/failover options, and documented maintenance windows for any managed relational database offering.
